proposed_verification_pipeline.purpose: Provide versioned successor checks for the 15 affected verifiers
proposed_verification_pipeline.requirement: Create separately named public-aware successor verifiers, maintaining every unrelated original assertion and original link count. For a historical link targeting one of the two 059 identities, first check the original link tuple against the unchanged historical metadata, then check the public path against its new identity through the explicit crosswalk. Emit status qualified_original_to_public_crosswalk, never direct_original_public_byte_match or old_verifier_passed. All non-059 references remain strict byte matches. Checkpoint 15 reads SDK and related historical reports; checkpoints 16–19 include archived redacted-path hash tuples and the documented fallback logic; checkpoints 20–29 contain the explicit direct-link records shown here.

Where an archived link path is a redacted placeholder, bind it only by the exact original hash and length plus its named checkpoint/member, inspected verifier code and matching transport record. Do not generalize the crosswalk to unrelated files, similarly named paths or hash-only guesses; unresolved ambiguities stay unresolved.
